comment: Professor Sullivan is one of the most genuine, kind professors I have had at Richmond. While her class is lecture heavy, students can decide the amount of effort and participation they are willing to put forth. If you decide to pay attention and actually listen to her the class can be very interesting and helpful. I would take her again!

My favorite class I have taken in all my years at the University of Richmond. Professor Sullivan makes a difficult topic understandable and extremely interesting to learn about. She goes beyond her job description and creates meaningful relationships with all her students. If you need to take ethics, definitely take it with Professor Sullivan.

Extremely nice woman. Two short essays, one small group project, and a multiple-choice final. Need to participate 3 times throughout the entire semester, and it is super easy. Honestly the class is REALLY boring... she just lectures the whole time (we usually finish early) and posts her notes online so you dont need to take notes yourself.
